record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Mahalath<WH04257>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The fool<WH05036> hath said<WH0559><WTH8804> in his heart<WH03820>, <FI>There is<Fi> no God<WH0430>. Corrupt<WH07843><WTH8689> are they, and have done abominable<WH08581><WTH8689> iniquity<WH05766>: <FI>there is<Fi> none that doeth<WH06213><WTH8802> good<WH02896>. <RF>Maschil: or, of instruction<Rf>

God<WH0430> looked down<WH08259><WTH8689> from heaven<WH08064> upon the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120>, to see<WH07200><WTH8800> if there were<WH03426> <FI>any<Fi> that did understand<WH07919><WTH8688>, that did seek<WH01875><WTH8802> God<WH0430>.
Every one of them is gone back<WH05472><WTH8804>: they are altogether<WH03162> become filthy<WH0444><WTH8738>; <FI>there is<Fi> none that doeth<WH06213><WTH8802> good<WH02896>, no, not one<WH0259>.

Have the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205> no knowledge<WH03045><WTH8804>? who eat up<WH0398><WTH8802> my people<WH05971> <FI>as<Fi> they eat<WH0398><WTH8804> bread<WH03899>: they have not called<WH07121><WTH8804> upon God<WH0430>.

There were they in great<WH06343> fear<WH06342><WTH8804>, <FI>where<Fi> no fear<WH06343> was: for God<WH0430> hath scattered<WH06340><WTH8765> the bones<WH06106> of him that encampeth<WH02583><WTH8802> <FI>against<Fi> thee: thou hast put <FI>them<Fi>  to shame<WH0954><WTH8689>, because God<WH0430> hath despised<WH03988><WTH8804> them. <RF>were...: Heb. they feared a fear<Rf>

Oh that<WH05414><WTH8799> the salvation<WH03444> of Israel<WH03478> <FI>were come<Fi> out of Zion<WH06726>! When God<WH0430> bringeth back<WH07725><WTH8800> the captivity<WH07622> of his people<WH05971>, Jacob<WH03290> shall rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799>, <FI>and<Fi> Israel<WH03478> shall be glad<WH08055><WTH8799>. <RF>Oh that...: Heb. Who will give salvation, etc<Rf><CM>
